1.zh: 奉　神旨意，作基督耶稣使徒的保罗和兄弟提摩太
1.en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

1.zh: 写信给歌罗西的圣徒，在基督里有忠心的弟兄。愿恩惠、平安从　神我们的父归与你们！
1.en: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我们感谢　神我们主耶稣基督的父，常常为你们祷告；
1.en: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

1.zh: 因听见你们在基督耶稣里的信心，并向众圣徒的爱心，
1.en: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

1.zh: 是为那给你们存在天上的盼望；这盼望就是你们从前在福音真理的道上所听见的。
1.en: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

1.zh: 这福音传到你们那里，也传到普天之下，并且结果，增长，如同在你们中间，自从你们听见福音，真知道　神恩惠的日子一样。
1.en: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

1.zh: 正如你们从我们所亲爱、一同作仆人的以巴弗所学的。他为我们作了基督忠心的执事，
1.en: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

1.zh: 也把你们因[圣]灵所存的爱心告诉了我们。
1.en: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

1.zh: 因此，我们自从听见的日子，也就为你们不住地祷告祈求，愿你们在一切属灵的智慧悟性上，满心知道　神的旨意；
1.en: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

1.zh: 好叫你们行事为人对得起主，凡事蒙他喜悦，在一切善事上结果子，渐渐地多知道　神；
1.en: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

1.zh: 照他荣耀的权能，得以在各样的力上加力，好叫你们凡事欢欢喜喜地忍耐宽容；
1.en: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

1.zh: 又感谢父，叫我们能与众圣徒在光明中同得基业。
1.en: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

1.zh: 他救了我们脱离黑暗的权势，把我们迁到他爱子的国里；
1.en: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

1.zh: 我们在爱子里得蒙救赎，罪过得以赦免。
1.en: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

1.zh: 爱子是那不能看见之　神的像，是首生的，在一切被造的以先。
1.en: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

1.zh: 因为万有都是靠他造的，无论是天上的，地上的；能看见的，不能看见的；或是有位的，主治的，执政的，掌权的；一概都是借着他造的，又是为他造的。
1.en: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

1.zh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。
1.en: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

1.zh: 他也是教会全体之首。他是元始，是从死里首先复生的，使他可以在凡事上居首位。
1.en: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

1.zh: 因为[父]喜欢叫一切的丰盛在他里面居住。
1.en: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

1.zh: 既然借着他在十字架上所流的血成就了和平，便借着他叫万有—无论是地上的、天上的—都与自己和好了。
1.en: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

1.zh: 你们从前与　神隔绝，因着恶行，心里[与他]为敌。
1.en: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

1.zh: 但如今他借着基督的肉身受死，叫你们与自己和好，都成了圣洁，没有瑕疵，无可责备，把你们引到自己面前。
1.en: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

1.zh: 只要你们在所信的道上恒心，根基稳固，坚定不移，不至被引动失去福音的盼望。这福音就是你们所听过的，也是传与普天下万人听的，我—保罗也作了这福音的执事。
1.en: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

1.zh: 现在我为你们受苦，倒觉欢乐；并且为基督的身体，就是为教会，要在我肉身上补满基督患难的缺欠。
1.en: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

1.zh: 我照　神为你们所赐我的职分作了教会的执事，要把　神的道理传得全备，
1.en: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

1.zh: 这道理就是历世历代所隐藏的奥秘；但如今向他的圣徒显明了。
1.en: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

1.zh: 神愿意叫他们知道，这奥秘在外邦人中有何等丰盛的荣耀，就是基督在你们心里成了[有]荣耀的盼望。
1.en: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

1.zh: 我们传扬他，是用诸般的智慧，劝戒各人，教导各人，要把各人在基督里完完全全地引到　神面前。
1.en: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

1.zh: 我也为此劳苦，照着他在我里面运用的大能尽心竭力。
1.en: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

2.zh: 我愿意你们晓得，我为你们和老底嘉人，并一切没有与我亲自见面的人，是何等地尽心竭力；
2.en: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

2.zh: 要叫他们的心得安慰，因爱心互相联络，以致丰丰足足在悟性中有充足的信心，使他们真知　神的奥秘，就是基督；
2.en: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

2.zh: 所积蓄的一切智慧知识，都在他里面藏着。
2.en: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

2.zh: 我说这话，免得有人用花言巧语迷惑你们。
2.en: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

2.zh: 我身子虽与你们相离，心却与你们同在，见你们循规蹈矩，信基督的心也坚固，我就欢喜了。
2.en: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

2.zh: 你们既然接受了主基督耶稣，就当遵他而行，
2.en: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

2.zh: 在他里面生根建造，信心坚固，正如你们所领的教训，感谢的心也更增长了。
2.en: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

2.zh: 你们要谨慎，恐怕有人用他的理学和虚空的妄言，不照着基督，乃照人间的遗传和世上的小学就把你们掳去。
2.en: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

2.zh: 因为　神本性一切的丰盛都有形有体地居住在基督里面，
2.en: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

2.zh: 你们在他里面也得了丰盛。他是各样执政掌权者的元首。
2.en: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

2.zh: 你们在他里面也受了不是人手所行的割礼，乃是基督使你们脱去肉体[情欲]的割礼。
2.en: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

2.zh: 你们既受洗与他一同埋葬，也就在此与他一同复活，都因信那叫他从死里复活　神的功用。
2.en: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

2.zh: 你们从前在过犯和未受割礼的肉体中死了，　神赦免了你们一切过犯，便叫你们与基督一同活过来；
2.en: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

2.zh: 又涂抹了在律例上所写、攻击我们、有碍于我们的字据，把它撤去，钉在十字架上。
2.en: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

2.zh: 既将一切执政的、掌权的掳来，明显给众人看，就仗着十字架夸胜。
2.en: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

2.zh: 所以，不拘在饮食上，或节期、月朔、安息日都不可让人论断你们。
2.en: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

2.zh: 这些原是后事的影儿；那形体却是基督。
2.en: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

2.zh: 不可让人因着故意谦虚和敬拜天使，就夺去你们的奖赏。这等人拘泥在所见过的，随着自己的欲心，无故地自高自大，
2.en: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

2.zh: 不持定元首。全身既然靠着他，筋节得以相助联络，就因　神大得长进。
2.en: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

2.zh: 你们若是与基督同死，脱离了世上的小学，为什么仍像在世俗中活着、服从那「不可拿、不可尝、不可摸」等类的规条呢？
2.en: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
“Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

2.zh: 这都是照人所吩咐、所教导的。说到这一切，正用的时候就都败坏了。
2.en: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

2.zh: 这些规条使人徒有智慧之名，用私意崇拜，自表谦卑，苦待己身，其实在克制肉体的情欲上是毫无功效。
2.en: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

3.zh: 所以，你们若真与基督一同复活，就当求在上面的事；那里有基督坐在　神的右边。
3.en: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

3.zh: 你们要思念上面的事，不要思念地上的事。
3.en: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

3.zh: 因为你们已经死了，你们的生命与基督一同藏在　神里面。
3.en: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

3.zh: 基督是我们的生命，他显现的时候，你们也要与他一同显现在荣耀里。
3.en: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

3.zh: 所以，要治死你们在地上的肢体，就如淫乱、污秽、邪情、恶欲，和贪婪（贪婪就与拜偶像一样）。
3.en: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

3.zh: 因这些事，　神的忿怒必临到那悖逆之子。
3.en: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

3.zh: 当你们在这些事中活着的时候，也曾这样行过。
3.en: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

3.zh: 但现在你们要弃绝这一切的事，以及恼恨、忿怒、恶毒、毁谤，并口中污秽的言语。
3.en: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

3.zh: 不要彼此说谎；因你们已经脱去旧人和旧人的行为，
3.en: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

3.zh: 穿上了新人。这新人在知识上渐渐更新，正如造他主的形象。
3.en: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

3.zh: 在此并不分希腊人、犹太人，受割礼的、未受割礼的，化外人、西古提人，为奴的、自主的，惟有基督是包括一切，又住在各人之内。
3.en: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

3.zh: 所以，你们既是　神的选民，圣洁蒙爱的人，就要存怜悯、恩慈、谦虚、温柔、忍耐的心。
3.en: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

3.zh: 倘若这人与那人有嫌隙，总要彼此包容，彼此饶恕；主怎样饶恕了你们，你们也要怎样饶恕人。
3.en: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

3.zh: 在这一切之外，要存着爱心，爱心就是联络全德的。
3.en: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

3.zh: 又要叫基督的平安在你们心里作主；你们也为此蒙召，归为一体；且要存感谢的心。
3.en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

3.zh: 当用各样的智慧，把基督的道理丰丰富富地存在心里，用诗章、颂词、灵歌，彼此教导，互相劝戒，心被恩感，歌颂　神。
3.en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

3.zh: 无论做什么，或说话或行事，都要奉主耶稣的名，借着他感谢父　神。
3.en: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

3.zh: 你们作妻子的，当顺服自己的丈夫，这在主里面是相宜的。
3.en: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

3.zh: 你们作丈夫的，要爱你们的妻子，不可苦待她们。
3.en: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

3.zh: 你们作儿女的，要凡事听从父母，因为这是主所喜悦的。
3.en: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

3.zh: 你们作父亲的，不要惹儿女的气，恐怕他们失了志气。
3.en: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

3.zh: 你们作仆人的，要凡事听从你们肉身的主人，不要只在眼前事奉，像是讨人喜欢的，总要存心诚实敬畏主。
3.en: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

3.zh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的，
3.en: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

3.zh: 因你们知道从主那里必得着基业为赏赐；你们所事奉的乃是主基督。
3.en: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

3.zh: 那行不义的必受不义的报应；[主]并不偏待人。
3.en: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

4.zh: 你们作主人的，要公公平平地待仆人，因为知道你们也有一位主在天上。
4.en: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

4.zh: 你们要恒切祷告，在此警醒感恩。
4.en: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

4.zh: 也要为我们祷告，求　神给我们开传道的门，能以讲基督的奥秘（我为此被捆锁），
4.en: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

4.zh: 叫我按着所该说的话将这奥秘发明出来。
4.en: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

4.zh: 你们要爱惜光阴，用智慧与外人交往。
4.en: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

4.zh: 你们的言语要常常带着和气，[好像]用盐调和，就可知道该怎样回答各人。
4.en: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

4.zh: 有我亲爱的兄弟推基古要将我一切的事都告诉你们。他是忠心的执事，和我一同作主的仆人。
4.en: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

4.zh: 我特意打发他到你们那里去，好叫你们知道我们的光景，又叫他安慰你们的心。
4.en: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

4.zh: 我又打发一位亲爱忠心的兄弟阿尼西谋同去；他也是你们那里的人。他们要把这里一切的事都告诉你们。
4.en: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

4.zh: 与我一同坐监的亚里达古问你们安。巴拿巴的表弟马可也问你们安。（说到这马可，你们已经受了吩咐；他若到了你们那里，你们就接待他。）
4.en: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

4.zh: 耶数又称为犹士都，也问你们安。奉割礼的人中，只有这三个人是为　神的国与我一同做工的，也是叫我心里得安慰的。
4.en: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

4.zh: 有你们那里的人，作基督耶稣仆人的以巴弗问你们安。他在祷告之间，常为你们竭力地祈求，愿你们在　神一切的旨意上得以完全，信心充足，能站立得稳。
4.en: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

4.zh: 他为你们和老底嘉并希拉坡里的弟兄多多地劳苦，这是我可以给他作见证的。
4.en: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

4.zh: 所亲爱的医生路加和底马问你们安。
4.en: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

4.zh: 请问老底嘉的弟兄和宁法，并她家里的教会安。
4.en: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

4.zh: 你们念了这书信，便交给老底嘉的教会，叫他们也念；你们也要念从老底嘉来的书信。
4.en: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

4.zh: 要对亚基布说：「务要谨慎，尽你从主所受的职分。」
4.en: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

4.zh: 我—保罗亲笔问你们安。你们要记念我的捆锁。愿恩惠[常]与你们同在！
4.en: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.
